summary: Align the Cargo and flake PTY pins at e237afa: scrub FRACTAL_* identity on restart

compatibility.detail: PTY advances from 063ff7f9 to e237afa (pty#178). Explicit, attach and picker restarts scrub inherited FRACTAL_AGENT and FRACTAL_ROOT alongside ST_AGENT and ST_ROOT so restarted children do not inherit the restarter's identity. Fresh runs still inherit both namespaces, and explicit --env assignments survive restart.

downtime.detail: No forced restarts; sessions use the selected binary on natural restart.

manual.detail: This dependency-only change does not activate services or modify storage. Matching Cargo and flake pins keep the evaluation-time assertion. Roll out the selected PTY binary with the consuming release.
